EmailTemplate.description: For internal use to send to advisors
EmailTemplate.name: INTL - Course Credits to DARS-Advisors
EmailTemplate.subject: Update on international transfer credits
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
The international transfer credits have been added to the student's DARS. Please run a new audit for the updates to appears. International transfer hours appear as one lump sum on the student's DARS record.
You should be able to see the evaluated transcript in WebXtender/AppXtender. If you are unable to see the transcript please let us know and we can send you a copy of the annotated transcript for you to review.
If you have any further questions or requests please send them to intltransreq@asu.edu.
Thank you,
International Admission Services Arizona State University
